intro: The Test of Lore is a trial of intellect and historical memory set by the hermit Braug Dimspirit in the Stonetalon Mountains. After retrieving the ancient tome Legacy of the Aspects, travelers must demonstrate their understanding of ancient history by answering Braug's inquiry. Those who fail to heed the text find themselves abruptly banished across Kalimdor.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You have brought me the book, and now it is time for your question. Are you ready?
Time is not an issue, adventurer, so do not feel pressured. You may take as long as you like to answer.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Life is full of questions, adventurer. You will never be able to answer all of them, but with some time and study, perhaps you will become a little more knowledgeable.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well done, adventurer. You have studied the text I asked you to, and now you have passed another of our tests.
